record.question: The present Home Minister of Mizoram is
record.explanation: Answer C: Lalchamliana. A Government of Mizoram protected-person list dated February 21, 2019 identifies Pu Lalchamliana as Home Minister. Reference: https://printingstationery.mizoram.gov.in/storage/site/files/Ex-138-2019.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
